search_window.basis: From the completed_at of the latest verified Food Line Source Watch heartbeat on ops/watch-ledger. Screened for newly announced/occurring disruptions, not indexed or crawled timestamps.

coverage_notes.purpose: Bounded supplementary recall only; primary national production collection is authoritative.
target_classes: Loss, closure, fire or disaster affecting only/sole/last/full-service community grocery
Cancellation or suspension of emergency food distribution caused by storm/flood/fire/outage/facility damage
Abrupt pantry/food bank service closure or material reduction in access
New official SNAP/WIC/food-assistance interruption causing immediate access consequences
bounded_query_context: November 1 2026 SNAP benefits interrupted state agency today November food assistance
November 1 2026 WIC benefits card outage disruption state agency
"only grocery store" closed fire November 1 2026 town
"last grocery store" closing November 2026 rural community
food pantry closed unexpectedly November 1 2026 fire water damage
food bank distribution canceled today November 1 2026 weather storm
SNAP EBT outage November 1 2026 service interruption official state
emergency food distribution canceled October 31 November 1 2026 flood power outage
coverage_notes.observation: Twelve targeted searches produced usable source results, but no newly reported qualifying U.S. food-access disruptions were verified within the bounded 10:46–11:43 PST window. Search results predominantly surfaced earlier 2026 grocery/fire notices, 2025 SNAP shutdown stories, routine weekend closures and food distribution scheduling; no credible current event meeting the inclusion conditions.

duplicate_screen.method: Read the most recent watch ledger entry on ops/watch-ledger and compared candidate dates and known exclusions.

coverage_notes.limitations: Search returned stale and unrelated high-ranked material despite exact November 2026 qualifiers. Newly posted local/provider or agency advisories might not yet be indexed. Zero findings does not establish absence of disruption nationwide.
coverage_notes.production_authority: No approval, publication, production-collector change, schedule change, or task disabling.
